findings.source: AmmCloseSwapServiceStable.sol:345-360 require(swapIdsLength <= poolCfg.maxLengthOfLiquidatedSwapsPerLeg, ...); for (uint256 i; i != swapIdsLength; ) {...}
findings.issue: The dominating test already proves both lengths are 0, so each 'while s != _12' (s starting at 0) can never run, yet about 1,800 lines per function of loop body are printed, including all the aborted paths; the second IPOR_315 test is implied by the first (P11).
findings.rule: Propagate a dominating unsigned test into later conditions: after 'if x > 0: revert' (or require x <= 0), x == 0; a loop 's = 0; while s != x' then has a false entry condition and is removed with everything only it reaches.
